name: Load a CT
summary: The View's loading dialog for CT scans: drop or choose a folder from your computer (a whole CD/DVD export is fine), see its series, tick the ones to segment and press Load; or give a folder on a worke
help: Put it on the flow's View next to the 3D anatomy. Wire the Live telemetry of the Load CT scans block, through a Telemetry block (channel ct_load), to Live. From this computer: the folder is read in your browser (only the DICOM tags that group and order images; never patient names or IDs), the series are listed with the best CT series of each study ticked, and Load starts a run and sends the ticked images, compressed, to the loader on the worker; the segmentation and the 3D models follow. From a worker's folder: the path on the worker. Wired files: the demo case, or a Dataset block wired to the loader. Settings: Loader node and Segmentation node, the node ids of those blocks in the flow (load and seg).
